systems.system: Tanzania-DRC national backbone link via Lake Tanganyika

COD.note: On the DRC side the document says only that assessment is done and permits obtained; no works begun and no partner body named there.

facts.fact: Tanzania's communications ministry reports that on 18 August 2026 the Kigoma side of the national backbone to DR Congo across Lake Tanganyika was 5 per cent built, with a beach manhole under construction and completion expected in April 2027.
